phase.current: after actual main IMU propagation/clone, before current finite Observer camera correction and before main visual update
phase.anchor: after previous finite Observer camera correction, before its main visual update; its covariance source correlation propagates through later main updates
phase.bias: frozen main estimated bias receipt before propagation; reused by subsequent Observer IMU integration

actor: independent one-slot native Observer with same q/V/P_R/floor/substep rules; not production30-slot crop

error_spaces.main: m=-native local estimate perturbation; map actual attitude true-est with M(e0) from independent mean/GT before renaming
error_spaces.observer: program mean variation equals est-true body-vector error variation at fixed physical truth/time/calibration; error mean is separate

conditions: declared initial prior law, not actual initializer/history-error calibration
fixed calibration/time; declared white raw IMU and pixel hypotheses
fresh historical seed sources only; previously consumed pixels before registration rejected
same identity/variance on reuse; supported clone/IMU expiry window and all-state/source QR preservation
model missing counter is cumulative without reason detail; unknown events cannot be declared benign

kernel.implemented: same-chart R_L/N_L/visual cross, stable correlated S/K/Pplus, program pose Jacobian; finite/symmetric/PSD checks and singular duplicate rejection

validation.known_truth_covariance_MC: 0.496% error,12000 samples; conditional linear-main nominal-zero-injection scope

consumer_policy: DO_NOT_USE_FOR_PRODUCTION30_SLOT_OR_B_APPROX_FUSION; no qualified online real covariance/mean interface
stop_reasons: initial/source/noise/gate law unvalidated in real streams
main error mean chart mapping not supplied online
landmark residual mean and real truth unavailable
registered source subset/missing events not full historic closure
